blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) and the Department of Labor and Employment (Dole) on Wednesday committed to investigate a plastic surgeon and his clinic. This comes after Sen. Raffy Tulfo raised alleged malpractice cases involving reported deaths of patients. During the Senate Committee on Finance hearing for the 2027 spending plan of DOLE and its attached agencies, Tulfo questioned PRC officials over the agency’s handling of complaints against the doctor. Tulfo cited a 2017 case involving a patient who allegedly died after undergoing multiple procedures at once, and another recent case involving a patient who reportedly suffered the […]...
